local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene') local me=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character local function motors(m) local t={} if m then for _,d in m:GetDescendants() do if (d:IsA('Motor6D') or d:IsA('AnimationConstraint')) then t[#t+1]=d end end end return t end local function sig(m) local s=0 local n=0 for _,d in motors(m) do n+=1 local x,y,z=d.Transform:ToEulerAnglesXYZ() s+=math.abs(x)+math.abs(y)+math.abs(z) end return n,s end local en=nil if f then for _,d in f:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA('Model') and d.Name=='FieldEnemy' then en=d break end end end local hum=me and me:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') local out={'RIG='..tostring(hum and hum.RigType)..' enemyFound='..tostring(en~=nil)..' enemyRig='..tostring(en and en:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') and en.Humanoid.RigType)} for i=1,6 do local n1,s1=sig(me) local n2,s2=sig(en) out[#out+1]=string.format('ME motors=%d sum=%.3f | ENEMY motors=%d sum=%.3f',n1,s1,n2,s2) task.wait(0.25) end return table.concat(out,'\n')

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene') local me=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character local hrp=me and me:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') local out={} if f and hrp then for _,m in f:GetChildren() do if m.Name=='FieldEnemy' and m:IsA('Model') then local n,s=0,0 for _,x in m:GetDescendants() do if x:IsA('Motor6D') or x:IsA('AnimationConstraint') then n+=1 local a,b,c=x.Transform:ToEulerAnglesXYZ() s+=math.abs(a)+math.abs(b)+math.abs(c) end end out[#out+1]=string.format('ENEMY d=%.0f motors=%d sum=%.3f',(m:GetPivot().Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude,n,s) end end end return table.concat(out,'\n')
